data.text: Vindicate me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity and trusted in the LORD; I will not slip.
data.titulo: A Prayer for Vindication and Grace

data.text: Examine me, LORD, and test me; refine my inmost thoughts and my heart.
For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I have walked in your faithfulness.
I have not sat with false men, nor will I join those who conceal what they are.
I hate the assembly of evildoers and will not sit with the wicked.
I wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, LORD,
to sound my thanksgiving aloud and recount all your wonders.
LORD, I love the dwelling of your house and the place where your glory resides.
Do not gather my soul with sinners or my life with bloodthirsty men,
data.titulo: A Plea for Preservation and Grace

data.text: whose hands hold wicked schemes and whose right hands are full of bribes.
But I will walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.
My foot stands on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless the LORD.
